subject: Re: CoDi kickoff - 4-step conditional generation as our efficiency headline
body:
Zofia,

Staffing: Csilla 60% on the distillation training runs, Tereza 70% on the conditional settings (inpainting first, InstructPix2Pix second), Oyin 50% on serving + tooling.

Compute: 128 A100s on titan-a100 for the distillation runs through April; short bursts, no reservation.

On publishing evals: there is no shared service that does this today, so we are scoping and building a benchmark leaderboard service from scratch - Oyin at 50% for six weeks plus roughly a third of Tereza's time on the submission/scoring backend. Scope: result submission API, FID/LPIPS scoring workers, and a public-internal leaderboard page per task. I know it's a chunk of the team, but every efficiency claim we make will get challenged, and self-reported spreadsheet numbers won't survive a launch review.

First leaderboard milestone April 10, seeded with our SR results.

Ivo
